blocks.text: Terpenes lipids ka bohat bara aur mukhtalif group hain. Saare terpenes isoprene units se bane hain. Isoprene unit ek shaakhdar unsaturated hydrocarbon zanjeer hai jis ka formula CH₂=C(CH₃)−CH=CH₂ hai. Terpenes bohat se biological taur par aham pigments (rang dene wale maadde) banate hain, jaise podon mein chlorophyll aur aankhon mein retinal pigments. Vitamin A aur rubber bhi terpenes hain.

blocks.alt: Baayen: isoprene unit CH2=C(CH3)-CH=CH2. Daayen: isoprene ikaiyon se bani terpene zanjeer, CH2=C(CH3)-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH(CH3)-CH2-CH2-OH.
